newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Konsortium's Mirzan sells shares in firm.
newsitem.headline: Konsortium's Mirzan sells shares in firm.

text.p: Group executive chairman of haulage and shipping firm Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd, Mirzan Mahathir, said he has sold 2.5 million shares of the company in the open market.
The sale on Sept 20 by his private company, Peringkat Prestasi (M) Sdn Bhd, amounted to about 1.55 percent of Konsortium's 160.9 million paid-up share capital.
Peringkat Prestasi in its statement to Konsortium, did not say at what price and to whom the shares were sold.
After the sale, Mirzan said his direct stake in Konsortium consisted of 174,522 shares and indirect stake at 91.48 million, or a total about 57 percent of Konsortium.
Mirzan is the eldest son of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
